music: Original procedural ambient composition by SOLID LIGHT

lines.intro: Hello, I am Luma. Your outline gives us length and height. I will find the depth. Pinch and hold, trace a closed loop around the ribbon, then release.
lines.chapter2: The incomplete span. First draw around the short ribbon. Let us see how far our light can reach.
lines.chapter3: Welcome to the Light Garden. First draw a thin lower path. Then we will add a separate roof above it.
lines.chapter4: The Last Spark. Build a sheltered crossing with a limited supply of light. A thinner outline saves energy.
lines.length: I can add depth, but I cannot add missing length. Extend your cyan outline across the amber marks.
lines.roof: Our path works. Now add a second closed loop around the upper roof guide. Keep the space between them clear.
lines.budget: Our shape uses too much light. Trim your outline inside the guide, then I will test it again.
lines.open: Bring the glowing end back to the start. Close your loop, then release.
lines.build: We found a safe route. Watch our traveler cross the light.
lines.success: We made it together. Choose Next level when you are ready.
lines.finale: We built this together. Your outline and my depth brought our traveler home. Thank you for creating with me.
